# Code of Conduct

We want Nakoda to be a friendly, respectful place to contribute, whoever you are and however much experience you have.

## Our standards

Please:

- Be kind and patient. Assume good intent and ask when something is unclear.
- Give and accept feedback on the work, not the person.
- Respect different opinions, skill levels and backgrounds.

Not acceptable:

- Harassment, insults, discrimination or personal attacks of any kind
- Unwelcome sexual attention or imagery
- Publishing other people's private information without permission
- Trolling, or other conduct that would reasonably be seen as inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, commits, issues and other contributions that don't follow this code, and may temporarily or permanently ban anyone for behavior they judge harmful.

To report a problem, open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/danangace/Nakoda/security/advisories/new) or contact the maintainer through their GitHub profile. Reports are handled privately.
